text:
Ivy (CS): quick draft of a 'mini kickoff primer' for customers — single page checklist for prefill, batching, streaming fallbacks, and renewal signals. posting so eng/ops can sanity-check.

Noah (Infra): love the one-pager idea. suggested defaults: prefill_requests=25, initial_batch=6 for chat UIs, initial_batch=3 for strict latency; concurrency=2. Recommend a 10m higher-concurrency window to populate KV caches.

Priya (SRE): Ops guardrails to include: alert if 5xx_rate > 3% for 3m OR p95_latency > 1s. On alert: scale down batch_size by 50%, shift 20% traffic to fallback-quantized, and escalate to #release-war-room. Add an observability query snippet.

Ivy (CS): customer-facing 1-liner to include in kickoff email:
"During onboarding we'll run a short priming window (20-60m) to warm caches and tune batching. We'll share a 24h metrics snapshot and do a 72h check-in. If errors rise we'll switch to a compact fallback and notify you."

Liam (PM): for renewal-risk capture, ask CS to record: baseline p90 at t0, cache-hit% after 24h, error-budget percent used, and a 72h customer sentiment tick (green/amber/red + note). Add these to the handoff doc.

Noah (Infra): small script customers can run to simulate priming (safe, low volume):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 25); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"priming ping","max_tokens":20}' &
  sleep 0.2
done
wait
```

Priya (SRE): add quick metric queries for the kickoff snapshot:
- success qps: `rate(http_requests_total{job="redwood",code!~"5.."}[5m])`
- cache hit rate: `sum(increase(cache_hits_total[1h])) / sum(increase(cache_lookups_total[1h]))`
- p90 latency: `histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`

Ivy (CS): short start-config table (customer-facing):
- prefill: 15-50 (depends on prompt set)
- batch_size: 3 (low latency) / 6 (balance)
- concurrency: 1-3 during priming
- warm_pool: request for Dedicated customers or high-throughput tenants

Liam (PM): include cost note: estimate token cost for prefill and call out Dedicated reserved warm pools as an option to minimize burst charges.

Ivy (CS): feedback capture: after 72h CS will fill a one-line answer: "Did priming reduce cold starts? (yes/no)" + short note. we'll attach that to the renewal playbook.

cs-bot: reminder set — follow-up for @Ivy (CS) in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:

Ivy (CS): thanks! I'll add this mini primer to the enablement repo and the kickoff email template. tag me for edits. :pray:
